disambiguation_rules: Use NY/NY-specific county wording in all local commercial terms. Erie County NY is the launch geography; Erie County PA is a separate county and may contaminate generic Erie searches.
Use Lancaster NY, Buffalo NY and Erie County NY when relevant; Lancaster SERPs returned Pennsylvania businesses and guides.
Do not treat ZIP codes or postal place names as legal municipality boundaries.
A shared name is one research group only when the query cannot practically distinguish town and village; preserve each legal jurisdiction in this inventory.
Gowanda is partly in Cattaraugus County; generic Gowanda demand cannot be assigned wholly to Erie.
Tonawanda query intent can mean City of Tonawanda or Town of Tonawanda; North Tonawanda is in Niagara County and must be excluded.
Do not create city/town/village pages from this list without firsthand local proof, a distinct buyer question and original evidence.
